story_type: cabin cruiser sinking stern first, cutter small boat pulls the boaters across
hook: Their boat was sinking stern first, with people still aboard.
narration: Their boat was going down stern first, with people still on board.
A small boat from the Coast Guard Cutter SPAR, a ship based in Kodiak, Alaska, pulled alongside.
The crew grabbed the boaters and pulled them across, one at a time.
Puget Sound stays cold all year, and cold water can drain a swimmer's strength in minutes.
Then the stern dropped away, and the crew hauled the last of them over the side.
[short pause] Minutes later, only the bow was still above the water.
outcome: The SPAR crew got the boaters off as their boat sank stern first into Puget Sound.
title: Boat sinking with people still aboard
description:
The crew of the Coast Guard Cutter SPAR, homeported in Kodiak, Alaska, rescues boaters from a sinking boat in Puget Sound, Washington, on April 20, 2007.
